steps: Fry the onion in half the oil until soft and light golden, then add the ginger, garlic and green chilli for a minute.
Add the chopped tomato and cook until very soft, about 5 minutes.
Let it cool a little and blend to a smooth paste.
Heat the rest of the oil, add the cumin, and when it sizzles pour in the paste.
Stir in the turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and salt and cook until oil shows at the sides, about 7 minutes.
Add the peas and about a cup of water for four people and simmer until the peas are soft.
Add the paneer, cream and crushed kasuri methi and simmer for just 2 minutes so the paneer stays soft.
Sprinkle the garam masala and coriander leaves and serve.
note: One recipe used about 15 g onion and 30 g tomato a person and the other about 55 g and 95 g; this follows the second, which gives a proper gravy to eat with roti.
